Yes. For non-reserved equipment, Rosario Fulfillment Center accounted for **1,858 of 3,184 errors (58.4%)**—a majority.

This was largely driven by **1,421 BarcodeReadFailure events**. Including maintenance-only equipment, Rosario still represented a majority: **2,016 of 3,573 events (56.4%)**.
